summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Adhikar prototype. 17/18 pytest tests pass. All key APIs (records, parcels, samples, upload, decision, files, seed) work correctly and return well-shaped data without MongoDB _id. Frontend dashboard, filters, sort, record detail (approve/reject, flag-reasons, no-gis-panel), Leaflet map (8 polygons, parcel-detail-panel), and Upload page (all 4 sample thumbs, file-input, sample click → OCR result + view-record-link) all work end-to-end. Demo state has been reset via POST /api/seed (10 records).

minor.issue: Returns status 'flagged: no GIS match' instead of expected 'flagged: area mismatch'. Root cause: EasyOCR misreads the khasra number on the generated sample_4 image, so it doesn't map to any parcel in PARCEL_INDEX. Recommend regenerating sample_4 with a clearer, larger khasra number that OCRs to '103/2' (an existing parcel) with an inflated area.

Observed OCR reads khasra as '777/2' (design intended unknown khasra), status correctly = 'flagged: no GIS match'. Works but sample_3 vs sample_4 OCR reliability suggests bigger fonts would harden the demo.

action_items: Regenerate sample_4_area_mismatch.png so EasyOCR reliably extracts khasra '103/2' (a real parcel) with area ~5.0 ha, ensuring status resolves to 'flagged: area mismatch' as the demo requires.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py extract_fields uses regex on OCR output — brittle to OCR noise. Consider adding fallback / fuzzy khasra matching (e.g. rapidfuzz against PARCEL_INDEX keys) so slight OCR errors still map to a parcel; would also make sample_4 area-mismatch flow more robust.
validate_record short-circuits on first duplicate match (break) but still returns first flag. Fine for demo, but consider aggregating flags so users see area + duplicate together.
create_record loads *all* records into memory each time (find({}).to_list(1000)); fine for hackathon scale, note for production.
startup event uses deprecated @app.on_event; consider FastAPI lifespan handler.
test_credentials: N/A — no auth in this hackathon prototype
seed_data_creation: Called POST /api/seed at end of testing; DB left with 10 seeded records for clean demo state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs in ~30s (first OCR call may be slower). Only known failure is test_process_sample_area_mismatch, caused by OCR misread on sample_4, not by validation logic. Frontend filter buttons use pattern data-testid=`filter-{status_with_colon_and_spaces_replaced_by_dashes}` preserving original case (e.g. filter-flagged-no-GIS-match).
rca of the issue: sample_4 area mismatch failure: pipeline -> EasyOCR reads khasra from generated PNG -> regex extracts survey_number -> validate_record does PARCEL_INDEX.get(sn); when OCR yields a value not present in the 8 seeded parcels ('101/1','102/3','103/2','104/1','105','106/2','107/1','108/4'), the record is flagged 'no GIS match' before the area-mismatch check runs. Mitigation: (1) render sample_4 with larger/clearer font for the khasra field, or (2) add fuzzy matching against PARCEL_INDEX keys in validate_record.
